findings.finding: da398d8 checks candidate then old, empty always valid, history and multiline bypass; preedit checked. Explicit invalid/required are separate. CUI callback protects same-model mutation unlike source mutable App callback.

Single-line source removes both CR and LF before candidate validation and default-value setup. CUI returns LINE_BREAK for CR/LF. U+2028 is not removed by that source helper. Number-mask normalization is conditional, not generic.

9 ASCII digit, A ASCII letter, # ASCII alphanumeric, * any scalar, other scalars separators. Prefixes are valid; formatting adds/skips literals. Number variant supports separators/fraction formatting. Mask rewrites document, adjusts caret and records whole-document atomic history when changed. Not password hiding.

Source regex::Regex is_match is search matching unless expression anchors itself. Validator runs first, then mask, then regex; empty bypasses all. Existing CUI callback can host an application predicate but is not a portable regex implementation or regex source compatibility.

findings.status: missing opt-in feature with mandatory security behavior when enabled
findings.finding: Source displays MASK_CHAR once per Unicode scalar, maps byte ranges to display offsets, double-click selects all, disables Copy and Cut, withholds accessibility value. CUI styled Input has no masked option; current plaintext drawing/clipboard/semantics must not be relabeled password support.

findings.status: missing opt-in semantic and platform feature
findings.finding: Source has 45 enum variants including name/address/credit card/credentials/OTP/date/cellular metadata. Styled role maps telephone/email/URL/password/date types; password/new-password suppress value exposure independently of masked drawing. Native NSTexContent seam is macOS-only; nonmac sync is no-op. SDL/browser autofill and keyboard hints require separate host capabilities, not portable metadata alone.

Common clipboard/select-all/grapheme/word/history/home/end exists; single-line vertical no-op and popup delegation tested. CUI combines Ctrl/Alt word operations regardless of OS; source macOS Ctrl-Backspace is scalar/grapheme Backspace, Cmd-Backspace/Delete delete to line edge, Cmd-Left/Right home/end, Ctrl-A/E home/end. Source character palette, Escape/search/replace/context actions are not implemented in Input. Editor-only actions are not automatically single-line requirements.

CUI click/Shift click/drag hits byte geometry and snaps edit boundaries. Source double-click word and triple-click line are separate selection modes; no equivalent click-count reducer exists in styled Input. Masked double-click has special all-selection privacy policy.

findings.status: state tracking subset, source event API missing
findings.finding: Source Focus/Blur/Change/PressEnter events, cursor blink start/stop and context-menu blur exception are explicit. CUI result changed/submitted plus retained focus grouping cover part; no corresponding event callback stream or cursor blink timer. Existing immediate result callers can observe flags but must not claim source event ordering.

findings.status: bounded synchronous seam, source async gap
findings.finding: Source async permission-gated paste rechecks editability, focused handle, document revision and selections before applying late result. CUI platform clipboard API is synchronous borrowed text; arbitrary delayed completion needs an explicit generation/target transaction. Current web host composition bridge does not prove async clipboard equivalence.

proposal: bounded opt-in single-line CR/LF normalization before acceptance
